# Reviews Table Feature Update
## Overall Requirement
Change review table feature to allow user to select row from artist gallery or select a row from prompt group to review instead of asking user to manually input prompt and upload image files manually. This way it will also avoid my app to store data at app side and keep all information to client side in their reviews.json. 

## Edge Case that needs to be handled
### Scenario 1.
client just opened the app, app should show a page to allow user to select source folder. The source folder can be either sorted image folder like we used in artist gallery or prompt grouping. it can also take a folder contains images which is supported in prompt grouping. Then client is directed to review table. review table will load reviews.json file from their source folder root. 

### Scenario 2.
at artist gallery or prompt grouping page, if client changed source folder, app should automatically update where to load reviews.json for reviews table page. if no reviews.json in new source folder, just keep reviews table page empty

## Conditions need to be met
- reviews.json should be stored at source folder root. source folder can be either sorted image folder like we used in artist gallery or prompt grouping. it can also take a folder contains images which is supported in prompt grouping. 
- reviews.json should be an array of review object. each review object should contain at least the following properties: 
  - id: a unique identifier for the review, can be generated by uuid or any other method. 
  - source: where the review is from, can be either "artist_gallery" or "prompt_grouping"
  - foreign_id: the id of the source data, if source is "artist_gallery", then foreign_id is the sorted image folder name. if source is "prompt_grouping", then foreign_id is the prompt group id. this is used to link the review to the source data.
  - rating: the rating object contains
    - anatomy: a number between 1 to 5
    - face: a number between 1 to 5
    - object: a number between 1 to 5
    - background: a number between 1 to 5
    - character: a number between 1 to 5
- reviews.json should be stored in a way that it can be easily read and updated by the app. it can be stored as a JSON file or any other format that can be easily parsed and updated by the app.
- when user select a row from artist gallery or prompt grouping, app should check if there is already a review with the same source and foreign_id, if yes, then load the existing review data to review form, if no, then keep review form empty for user to fill in.
- when user submit the review, app should update reviews.json file accordingly. if there is already a review with the same source and foreign_id, then update the existing review, if no, then create a new review and add to reviews.json.
- app should also provide a way for user to delete a review, when user delete a review, app should remove the review from reviews.json file accordingly, but it should not delete the source data in artist gallery or prompt grouping, it should only delete the review data in reviews.json.
- review table should show all reviews from reviews.json file, and it shows ratings data in individual columns, and it also shows thumbnail of the image chosen from first image of multiple images in the source data. for example, if the review is from artist gallery, then it will show the thumbnail of the first image in the sorted image folder, if the review is from prompt grouping, then it will show the thumbnail of the first image in the prompt group. Each row also shows the source information of the review. It can be artist gallery or prompt grouping.
- review table should also provide a way for user to edit a review, when user click row in review table, it will open review form with the existing review data, user can edit the review data and submit, app should update reviews.json file accordingly.
- when user open the app, it should show a page to allow user to select source folder same way as we used in artist gallery or prompt grouping, it can also take a folder contains images which is supported in prompt grouping. after user select source folder, it will direct user to review table page.
- review table page should also provide a way for user to change source folder, when user change source folder, app should automatically update where to load reviews.json for reviews table page. if no reviews.json in new source folder, just keep reviews table page empty.
- when user changed source folder at artist gallery or prompt grouping page, app should automatically update where to load reviews.json for reviews table page. if no reviews.json in new source folder, just keep reviews table page empty.
- When user clicked thumbnail in review table, it should open the image in larger view, and also show the prompt and other metadata information of the image. user should also be able to navigate to next image or previous image in the source data when they are in the larger view of the image. Use image-review-modal component for this feature.

## Coding Pattern
- avoid duplicated code, try to reuse existing code as much as possible.
- keep the code modular and organized, try to separate different functionalities into different files or modules.
